name: serial_10_fold_dilution_of_culture_in_saline_20261112-222802
protocol_name: Serial 10-fold dilution of culture in saline
simulated_on: PyLabRobot's STAR model, configured as this instrument

review.protocol: Serial 10-fold dilution of culture in saline
assumptions: Read the protocol's 1 mL culture in 10 mL solvent as a 1:10 dilution step: 10 µL culture is mixed into 90 µL saline per well, scaled by 1/100 from the bench volumes. Each later column is 10 µL of the previous column into 90 µL fresh saline.

Six serial dilutions (columns 1–6 = 10^-1 to 10^-6) were chosen because the protocol does not state how many steps are needed. The scientist should confirm that the 10–100 CFU/mL target falls within these columns for the expected culture density.
The culture is loaded into a 1.9 mL reservoir instead of a tube, because the 8-channel head needs a multi-well source. 500 µL is loaded: 80 µL is needed for column 1 plus dead volume.
Diluent loaded is 5000 µL: 6 columns × 90 µL × 8 rows = 4320 µL, plus dead volume.
Each serial-transfer column is mixed by aspirating and dispensing 50 µL in place before the 10 µL transfer. The last column (10^-6) is mixed with its own fresh tips at the end of the run.

Tips are changed every time the source changes, so each tip column is used once. The diluent is dispensed with one tip column for all six columns, which is allowed because the tips only aspirate from the same source.

The saline is assumed to be pre-sterilized and the culture aseptically handled. Plating, colony counting and incubation are outside the robot and are not in the steps. The plate must be removed and plated by hand after the run.

dilution_plate.source: capacity from VENUS CORNING-COSTAR/Cos_96_PCR.rck; dead volume and fill fraction from config/precheck_policy.json

suggestions.title: 'diluent' starts 4.0 mm deep and ends 0.5 mm deep
suggestions.detail: 5000 uL spreads thin in this container. Below about 2 mm a tip draws air or misses the liquid; the simulator checks volume, not depth. Load more, or use a narrower container (a tube) for a small volume.
suggestions.request: Keep at least 2 mm of liquid in 'diluent' to the end of the run: load more, or move this reagent to a container narrow enough for its volume.

suggestions.title: 'culture' starts 0.4 mm deep and ends 0.3 mm deep
suggestions.detail: 500 uL spreads thin in this container. Below about 2 mm a tip draws air or misses the liquid; the simulator checks volume, not depth. Load more, or use a narrower container (a tube) for a small volume.
suggestions.request: Keep at least 2 mm of liquid in 'culture' to the end of the run: load more, or move this reagent to a container narrow enough for its volume.

suggestions.title: 6 trips to 'diluent' for 90 uL each, with 360 uL tips
suggestions.detail: One aspirate could feed 4 dispenses, so 2 trip(s) would do instead of 6. Multi-dispensing is less accurate than one aspirate per dispense (the first and last shots differ), so this is a trade of time against precision.
suggestions.request: Fill steps 2-13 by multi-dispensing: aspirate enough for up to 4 dispenses at a time from 'diluent'.
